summary: Model gateway, endpoint governance, call/usage ledger and hierarchical budget reservations. E2E-10 and E2E-12 passed and E2E-11 passed at the gateway level on actual PostgreSQL with a deterministic FIXTURE transport; one bounded live run of the local adapter against a real Ollama passed; hosted adapters were not exercised live.

environment.postgresql: 17.6 (docker, compose.yaml), dedicated database pcb_prompt08_test, migrated from empty through 9d3a71c05e24

evidence_levels.fixture: ScriptedTransport replays deterministic HTTP outcomes and faults (timeout after send, connect refusal, 429, 5xx, malformed 2xx, missing or zero usage, hostile echo of a secret). Provider bodies in tests/fixtures/model_gateway/*.json are hand-written from each provider's documented schema.
evidence_levels.integration: Real PostgreSQL ledger, triggers, row locks, partial unique indexes and advisory locks; real S3-compatible artifact store; real loopback sockets for the pinned transport.
evidence_levels.live: tests/test_model_gateway_live_smoke.py against a real local Ollama only. Evidence: docs/implementation/evidence/prompt-08-live-smoke-local.json
evidence_levels.not_run: OpenAI-compatible (hosted), Anthropic and Google adapters against live endpoints; any paid provider call; the two-model live pilot (Prompt 17 / E2E-31).

commands.command: alembic -c packages/persistence/alembic.ini upgrade head; alembic ... check (empty pcb_prompt08_test)
commands.result: PASS: 10 revisions applied, no schema drift

commands.command: uv run --offline --locked --all-packages pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_model_gateway_units.py tests/test_model_gateway_fixtures.py

commands.result: PASS: local adapter; SKIPPED (untested): openai_compatible, anthropic, google
PASS: 247 passed, 7 skipped (Docker lifecycle opt-ins and live cases without configuration)

E2E-10.observed: Nine concurrent calls across two sibling attempts for an allowance of three: exactly three reached the transport, six were refused before dispatch and left no call intent; open reservations equalled three bounds while the calls were in flight; 16 parallel threads reserved exactly five of sixteen with no deadlock; every account re-derived from the immutable ledger without discrepancy.

E2E-11.status: gateway subcase passed; full scenario not_run until Prompt 09
E2E-11.observed: A restarted gateway consumed the stored response, or settled already-persisted raw bytes, with zero further transport requests and unchanged spend; a recorded definitive failure was replayed without a new sample; reusing a key with different request bytes or a different model config conflicted; when two deliveries answered, only the first to arrive was consumed and both were billed.

E2E-12.observed: A timeout after send left the whole bound as uncertain exposure; the retry reserved a second bound (snapshot: 0 spent, 1 bound reserved, 1 bound uncertain); the ambiguous delivery has no usage record and no zero cost; missing or partial usage stayed NULL with exposure retained; reconciliation is append-only, needs cited evidence and cannot book a cost twice.

E2E-09_model_usage_half.status: passed with fixture transport; ranked-release exclusion and live usage remain Prompt 17

reproduced_before_fixing: turn lost after a retried or unbilled delivery
reservation smaller than the wire output cap

known_limits: Hosted adapters are verified only against documented-shape fixtures; live behavior is unknown.
Exactly-once billing cannot be guaranteed; ambiguity is bounded and disclosed.
Ollama returned no provider request id; the gateway records NULL rather than inventing one.
Price snapshots, context windows and capability declarations for real model configurations are operator inputs that were not supplied.
